npc:1569.text: No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.

npc:244808.text: Welcome back to the light, friend. Do you require training?

npc:259118.text: I am Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring. What brings you before me today?

npc:276171.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

npc:2851.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:3310.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

npc:3368.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

npc:4551.text: How may I be of service?

npc:4568.text: Greetings.  I'm an undead $c trainer, and you're a $c.

If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

npc:5883.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

npc:9087.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

npc:9501.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

accept.text: About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it.$b$bI am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.$b$bSpeak with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel at the base of the hill, he will tell you more of what you must know.

We Forsaken are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the undead, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.$b$bThe northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.

complete.text:
It is unfortunate that the Scourge cannot be brought into the fold, their large numbers would be useful in the battles ahead.

But they will not join us, so we have no choice but to destroy them.

objectives.text: Shadow Priest Sarvis wants you to kill 8 Mindless Zombies and 8 Wretched Zombies.

complete.text:
Thank you, $N. This armor should help you out.

Hopefully, it should do you more good than the last one to wear it...

progress.text: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.

complete.text:
Hmm, well, it's a start. It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation. After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.

You've done your duty well, $N, I'm sure I can find something else for you to do.

accept.text: So excited I am!$b$bThree little cages for three little elves! But what shall we do with our lovely tree-hugging friends? Why, let's give them a taste of... what do they call it... forest magic!$b$bI'll need a good mess of Stonetalon sap. From those horrid felines, bring me some twilight whiskers. This calls for plenty of courser eyes, of course -- can never have enough eyes. Oh, and lest we forget, a precious scale from a fey dragon.$b$bHurry to Stonetalon Peak, $n, so I can brew some forest magic!

objectives.text: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin wants 5 portions of Stonetalon Sap, 5 Twilight Whiskers, 30 Courser Eyes and a Fey Dragon Scale.

complete.text:
Ahh, a letter from Darsok. I have not heard from him in many years.

So the last of the Bloodfeathers are dead, eh? That is good news, I can remember when my friend Rokhan went with that crazy mok'nathal to kill her older sister. Ah, to be young again, like you.

progress.text: You seem a shady character. You have something for me to see?

complete.text:
So, $N, you have come.  Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?

If so, young $c, then listen on...

accept.text: At times we hunt for food.  At times we hunt for honor.  And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.$B$BBut the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things.  It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.$B$BThe hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens.  He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.$B$BFind Steelsnap, $n.  Find him, and defeat him.

objectives.text: Bring Steelsnap's Rib to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

complete.text:
I am finished with you, $N - you have shown yourself to be worthy of the freedom that you have been given.  Many will stand against you for what you have become, but know that no matter what they may try to do against us, we are free and will not be shackled again.

Take these and be on your way.  You have much to accomplish, $c.
Great work $N, I knew you weren't useless.  Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.

progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!

complete.text:
Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances. 

Be well and walk in the light once more, $c.

progress.text: Mastery of the light will return, in time.

complete.text:
Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.

I will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, $N.

accept.text:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.

complete.text: Arrival of the courageous few? Mind your voice.

objectives.text: Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deathstalker Agent in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.

accept.text: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.

complete.text: It is a favored sign to have a stranger approach in this manner. I feel a power amidst you... what is this you have brought?

objectives.text: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.

progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?

accept.text:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.

complete.text:
Don't mind me snatching that right out of your hands.

I recognized that orcish scrawl. So they're hoping to appease Rend? A fruitless and wasted effort. 

No matter, this is highly valuable knowledge for the dark lady to consider.

Here, I won't be taking any of this with me--and don't talk about the mission, grunt.

objectives.text: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.

progress.text: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.

accept.text:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?

complete.text: Look at the marbling on these! What are they eating up there? Thank you for going all the way and back for us. If you don't mind waiting, we'll cook some for you now, on the house, of course!

objectives.text: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.

progress.text: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?

accept.text:
Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there.

Some say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.

complete.text:
Heh... when I said unique properties, I wasn't kiddin' mon! You seem no worse for wear, so it be all good.

Thank you for your aid, $c. It be much appreciated.

objectives.text: Use the Toxin Extractor to gather $1oa Gloomrise Toxin Samples from the Gnawed Corpses at Gloomrise.

progress.text: Did ya get what I need?

accept.text:
There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.

complete.text: Thank you for your service to the people of this land. It may take time for us to completely clear out the infestation, but your efforts have created a stable foothold for us to leverage against these vile creatures.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Gloomrise Hatchlings and $2oa Gloomrise Soldiers.

accept.text:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.

complete.text:
These are excellent samples, and more than sufficient for my needs.

Here, take this. I was able to craft a rather unique cloak with a weave I spun from the small sample of silk already in my possession. I am hopeful that you will find it useful in your travels.

Earthmother watch over you, $c.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.

progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.

accept.text:
As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.

complete.text:
Reanimated dead? The broodmother possessing a night elven form? These are troubling revelations. One has to wonder what it all means... I fear that must be a concern for a later time.

Thank you, $N. You've done the Earthen Ring and the people of Mulgore a great service.

accept.text:
<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.

You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>

complete.text:
This is... most disturbing. Why would a druid be behind a brood of dangerous spiders? Who or what is this "Wild King" and "Pact" that is referenced in this letter?

I will confer with the druids of the Cenarion Circle on this. Perhaps they will know more.

Thank you again for your aid. As disturbing as this information is, we will rest easier knowing that the person controlling these vile creatures has been destroyed.

objectives.text: Bring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.

complete.text: Your training can now begin in earnest, $c. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.

accept.text:
Truly, this is a fascinating object.

It shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.

While our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the Earthen Ring are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.

You can find him and other elders of the Earthen Ring council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.

complete.text:
Ah... this shard hums with the voice of the world itself. The light within is a memory from the past, glimmering with flashes of history. This titan machine must have been waiting to be understood for lifetimes.

You've done wisely to bring it to us. The Earthen Ring will safeguard it, study it, and share the truths it keeps when we are able to receive its messages.

You honor the elements today, traveler.

objectives.text: Bring the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.

progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
